scope: Module-level reference boundaries inside crates/rx-application/src/engine. Every module declared from engine/mod.rs belongs to one group; submodule files count for their top-level module.
rule: A file may reference engine modules only from the groups that its own group lists in may_reference. Every other reference must be listed in allowed_violations with its current count. That list records seams to remove, not permissions: entries and counts may only decrease.
analysis_limit: Textual resolution of super::, crate::engine:: and bare module paths that reach an engine module through the use super::* chain, outside #[cfg(test)] items. The checker does not type-check, follow re-exports, or see macro-generated paths, and it does not judge whether a reference is appropriate.

core.description: Generic runtime: admission, identity and access, lifecycle, evidence and delivery, dispatch, reconciliation and settlement, invalidation, observation, host link and recovery, peers, requests, queries, diagnostics, store restore.

cell.description: Cell and production domain: workflow, production, handover, operator start, assignment, run configuration, closure, intervention, procedure, process execution and checkpoints, executor requests, runtime skills, cell configuration.

change_control.description: Change control and qualification: package intake, drafts and their bindings, reviews, process change, apply, host configuration dispatch, host binding intents, requalification, qualification activation.

allowed_violations.reason: Cell readiness consults qualification activation state (check_ready) and the run purpose (purpose).
Run admission requires the run's bound configuration to be current (require_current).
Assignment candidates compare configuration references through process_change::config_ref.
Delivery compares the cleared block set with the armed qualification blocks (arm_clear).
Dispatch checks node eligibility when the cell configuration carries a process (eligible_node).
Executor replacement suspends qualification activation for the touched cells (suspend_for_executor_replacement).
Re-admission reads the host binding intent named by the Host (read).
The expected configuration and the binding baseline derive from a staged process change (change).
Recovery context computes the prospective impact of a change on the host (prospective_impact).
A continuity proof reads the host configuration task it names (read).
A continuity proof checks the state of the applied process change (change).
Engine::open records qualification changes and suspends changed roots on restart (cell_change, record_blocks, suspend_changed_roots).
Operator start checks the run purpose against the activated qualification and records the armed clear blocks (purpose, arm_clear).
Applying a change binds the new configuration to the affected runs (bind).
Run bindings store and read configurations through process_change (read_config, store_config, config_ref).
The installed process skill digest uses process_change::config_ref.
Settlement releases confirmed work and completes part transitions through handover (release_confirmed, complete_part_transition).
Settlement compares the run's bound configuration with the cell configuration (read).
